paragraphs: I'm an Electrical and Information Engineering graduate from the Faculty of Engineering, University of Ruhuna, specializing in software engineering, with a keen interest in web development and agentic AI application development.

I currently work as an Associate Software Engineer at Global Wavenet International (Pvt) Ltd, where I build agentic AI applications and voice AI agents for telecommunication and call center operations, and contribute to full stack product development.

I have hands-on experience across the stack: React, Next.js, Node.js and Express, Python FastAPI and Flask, Java Spring Boot, and mobile development with Flutter. On the AI side I work with LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG pipelines, and the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs.
Adept at taking on responsibilities, passionate about learning new stacks, and committed to contributing effectively to team goals.

projects.intro: A mix of production systems I build at work and research-driven academic projects. Each card lists the stack it was built on.

items.title: Easy Rent
items.description: A rental marketplace that makes finding a place to stay straightforward, covering houses, apartments, annexes, boarding houses and rooms. Owners list properties with photos, rent, facilities and location, while renters search and filter by area, budget, property type and availability, then contact owners directly. Built with a React front end and a Node.js and Express backend over MySQL, with Keycloak handling authentication and role based access for owners and renters. Planned next: a payment gateway for booking fees and advance payments, map based search, and an AI assistant that answers listing questions in natural language.

items.title: Sense AI
items.description: Five AI agent applications built to replace human voice agents in call centre operations. Agents are orchestrated over IVR systems and integrated with a call centre management application, alongside contributions to the Workforce Management System.

items.title: Agentic Campaign Manager
items.description: Three specialised agents covering campaign creation, segment creation and data visualisation with database retrieval, orchestrated behind a supervisor agent that handles form filling and natural-language database interaction. Shipped with a new React and ShadCN UI connected through a Flask backend.

items.title: Troubleshooter
items.description: An agentic AI web application for operations engineers that resolves customer level 1 and level 2 tickets and processes Zabbix alerts. I contributed React front end, Express backend, Keycloak authentication, database and AI integration, then deployed it with Nginx, PM2 and later Docker. Demonstrated to more than five large-scale companies and now used by the internal operations team.

items.title: Compose
items.description: Rebuilt the front end of the Compose project in React, migrating away from an existing Angular 7 implementation, with Ant Design components and REST API integration throughout.

items.title: InsightDB
items.description: An AI agent that queries databases using natural language. I worked across the full stack, on the LangChain and RAG integration, and on deployment to a local Linux server behind Nginx.

items.title: Tea Leaf Disease Detection via Machine Learning
items.description: Final year research project, published and presented at the APITT International Conference 2024. Machine learning and deep learning models classify tea leaf diseases into distinct classes using a novel dataset collected for the project, with the deep learning model deployed on Hugging Face. I implemented the models, image preprocessing, user authentication, the Flutter mobile UI/UX and the Flask backend deployed on Google Cloud.

items.title: Fuel Management System
items.description: Four web portals and one mobile application that manage the fuel quota allocated to each vehicle, modelled on the system Sri Lanka used during the pandemic. I built the mobile application with its related microservices and the inter-service communication between them.

items.title: Final Year Project Marks Portal
items.description: A web application for entering final year project marks for the Department of Electrical and Information Engineering. I helped build user authentication and implemented all CRUD operations for the dynamically changing evaluation forms, one of the project's core features.

blog.author: Admin
blog.title: Chat Bot Development with the OpenAI Assistant API: A Step-by-Step Guide
excerpt: Are you looking to generate responses to questions by using AI? Look no further! OpenAI's Assistant API provides a powerful tool for developers to create natural language generation (NLG) applications. This blog post will explain the basics of using the OpenAI Assistant API with a simple code example.

Here I will show how to create AI assistants within your applications to generate answers for the questions based on the uploaded files, and databases. Open AI API provides the three most significant tools. These are code interpreter, retrieval, and Function calling. In this blog post, I will use retrieval and function calling to develop a chatbot.
blog.summary: A step-by-step walkthrough of building a chatbot on OpenAI's Assistant API, using retrieval and function calling to answer questions from your own files and databases.
